title: Watch a timed stream
summary: interval emits a growing count at a chosen time gap.
introduction: interval emits a growing count at a chosen time gap. Your task: Change the gap to 500 milliseconds.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for watch a timed stream

blocks.text: interval emits a growing count at a chosen time gap. Its first value is zero, after the first gap.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `take` completes after the chosen number of emitted values. It counts values rather than elapsed seconds.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: About one second apart, the outputs are 0, 1 and 2, then it stops.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Timing is approximate and can be delayed by the environment. Do not use it as an exact clock.
